description: 울산항만공사_울산항 수출입 화물정보 [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 울산항만공사. - 울산항 수출입 화물정보를 국가중점데이터로 개방하여, 이용자들의 편의성을 제고하고 항만 운영의 투명성을 강화하고자 합니다. - 본 데이터를 통해 울산항 선박 내 화물정보(양적하 및. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
